META_IMAGE_PICKER.Title: Change Actor Potrait & Token Images
META_IMAGE_PICKER.Menu: Select a new artwork for this Actor from the available options below.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.Token: The Top-Down Token will be updated accordingly.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.Wildcard: Configure this Actor to have Wildcard Tokens.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.WildcardExplain: Enabling this option and selecting an Image below, will configure the Actor to use the selected Image as the Portrait (Actor) Image, while each Token will use an Image with the same name (eg. 'Civilian-') as the selected Image, and use a random number each time. This will also force the Actor to become unlinked, meaning you can place multiples on a Scene and they each have their own Name/Life/Destiny etc.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.appendNumber: Append a Number to the Name of each Token.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.prependAdjective: Prepend an adjective to the Name of each Token
META_IMAGE_PICKER.TokenOptions: You can select any additional options for naming the Wildcard Tokens.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.isToken: You are editing a Token, to edit the parent Actor, use the Sidebar. If the Actor has the Wildcard option enabled, selecting an Image here will apply the corresponding Top-Down Token for this Token.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.ManualTooltip: Click here for the default Foundry VTT behavior. The Token Image will not be updated automatically.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.Error: No Images found in the Artwork Registry for this Actor Type.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.Untrusted: It seems your User doesn't have the 'Use File Browser' Permission. Ask your Narrator to give your user this permission, or promote you to a Trusted Player from the User Permission Configuration screen.
META_IMAGE_PICKER.actorLinkTooltip: Is this Actor's PrototypeToken linked? Can be true or false. Changing the Wildcard checkbox will toggle this option automatically. The default value is set according to the Actor's Type.

MATERIAL.Category: The type of Materials used in creating this Possession.
MATERIAL.Durability: The durability of this Possession. When this Possession takes damage, which is higher than the Resistance for that damage type, excess damage reduces the Durability of the Possession. When Durability reaches 0, the Possession is destroyed.
MATERIAL.Cosmic: The Cosmic Resistance of this Possession. If the Possession is an Armor, this Resistance value should be applied to the Actor when equipped. This is a manual process that needs to be done by the Narrator.
MATERIAL.Elemental: The Elemental Resistance of this Possession. If the Possession is an Armor, this Resistance value should be applied to the Actor when equipped. This is a manual process that needs to be done by the Narrator.
MATERIAL.Material: The Material Resistance of this Possession. If the Possession is an Armor, this Resistance value should be applied to the Actor when equipped. This is a manual process that needs to be done by the Narrator.
MATERIAL.Psychic: The Psychic Resistance of this Possession. If the Possession is an Armor, this Resistance value should be applied to the Actor when equipped. This is a manual process that needs to be done by the Narrator.

SETTINGS.metaAdvancedLoggingHint: The Console helps you identify any issues or potential bugs in regards to Metanthropes System for Foundry VTT. Enable this setting to see even more detailed logs in the Console. You can press 'F12' in the Foundry Client or 'CTRL+SHIFT+i' in a Chrome-ium web browser to show the Console.
SETTINGS.forceMigrationHint: Forces the System to migrate this World's data to the latest version. Migration happens on the first World load after an update, and you can force to run it again by enabling this setting. To get support with any issues after updating, contact us at support@metanthropes.com or join our Discord. This setting requires a reload and it will be disabled automatically once it completes.
SETTINGS.metaPauseHint: Enable this setting to automatically un-pause the World after initializing the System and Modules.
SETTINGS.welcomeMsgHint: Display the System Welcome Message on the next World load.
SETTINGS.metaWelcomeHint: Enable this setting to display the Metanthropes Welcome Journal when the World loads.
SETTINGS.metaInstallHint: Enable to show the System Demo Adventure Importer on the next startup.
SETTINGS.dsnDamageDiceName: Damage Color Theme for Dice So Nice!
SETTINGS.dsnDamageDiceHint: This setting requires the Dice So Nice! module to be active. Enabling will change the color theme of Damage dice to match the Energy Type being used. Disable to use your custom color theme for Damage rolls.
